title: Black Whale evidence-bounded spatial graph
purpose: Normalize confirmed scene identities, containment, access and route evidence without converting editorial sequence or visual similarity into geometry.
principles: Nodes represent evidence-backed identities or explicit unknown containers, not meshes.
Edges require independent support and never arise from page order alone.
Containment does not imply coordinates, dimensions or adjacency.
Access state and physical connection are separate edge classes.
Unknown endpoints and unresolved tiers remain explicit graph objects.
Temporary security, occupancy and Nen states are overlays, not permanent edges.
A traversable route requires stronger evidence than shared tier membership.
Contradictory relations remain quarantined and unavailable to navigation.

edgeClasses.meaning: A larger evidenced container includes a scene identity at an unspecified position.
A threshold is explicitly shown or stated to open to another identified space.
A physical connection is independently supported but its exact shape may remain unknown.
Operational access is controlled by a gate, checkpoint, authority or credential.
Macro stacking order only; no lift, stair or route is implied.
A supported one-way or directional exit relation.
Narrative or operational association without spatial linkage.
Evidence suggests a relation but it remains quarantined.
Records an incompatible placement or identity claim.

authoringPolicy.minimumEvidenceForContainment: explicit tier/location statement or stable registry assignment
authoringPolicy.minimumEvidenceForTraversableEdge: explicit doorway, route, passage, lift, stair, gate or movement relation with independently identified endpoints
authoringPolicy.unknownSpacePolicy: Do not create filler nodes or edges. Preserve unresolved endpoints as unknown.
authoringPolicy.geometryPolicy: No coordinates, lengths, widths, heights or angles are authorized in Phase 7.2 unless explicitly sourced.

completionGates: Every registry node receives one normalized container or an explicit unresolved assignment.
Every authored edge has evidence references, certainty, traversal policy and contradiction status.
No page-order-only or visual-similarity edge exists.
All 145 Phase 7.1C quarantines are mapped, superseded or explicitly carried forward.
Graph audit, browser QA and build checks pass.
Spatial graph dashboard is deployed and live-verified.
